ide_assets.storage: mapped onboard flash; included in firmware, no separate asset partition
ide_assets.execution: GP WASM/data executes in the PC browser RAM, not MCU RAM

linker_allocations.internal_remainder_note: Used by the common libc malloc arena; do not add again to measured libc free bytes. IRAM/DRAM aliases must not be summed.
linker_allocations.note: The dummy section is virtual mapping padding, not occupied physical PSRAM. Capacity outside actual sections is not a measured or necessarily allocatable free heap. The reserved external heap is not the current common libc malloc pool.

runtime_memory_under_browser_and_vm_load.load: Authenticated real GUI running a one-million-iteration count/say program; stopped after sampling.
runtime_memory_under_browser_and_vm_load.scope: Allocator pools only; excludes static arrays, stacks, unassigned PSRAM and free objects inside the fixed 64 KiB VM arena.

correction: Supersedes the earlier physical_psram_minus_static_allocation estimate, which incorrectly counted mapping padding as occupied physical RAM.
